title: ACN: Introduce dissector table for SDT wrapped protocols
description:
Introduce an extra dissector table into ACN for the wrapped protocol in SDT messages.\
This allows the writing of custom dissector plugins for the DMP parts of ACN (reasons below).\
I have also introduced a preference to add the wrapped protocol to the root tree, as that makes it nicer to look at.

**Notes on DMP (why use plugins):**

In DMP devices are controlled via properties. Each property has a 32-bit address.\
DMP sends property data as a packed stream of `<address><property_data><address><property_data>...` with no markers in-between.\
The meaning of the addresses, _and the length of the associated data items_ is defined in a description file on a per-device basis, which means that we can't properly dissect these messages as we don't know where the addresses and data items are, or what they actually mean.\
With plugin you can create one for a specific device type, which knows this information and can then properly interpret it.

I've attatched a plugin below which does this for the ACN sample capture here:

https://wiki.wireshark.org/samplecaptures#user-content-architecture-for-control-networks-acn

[ACN_Wrap.lua](/uploads/44d1004f11fa489247d4ad5927ea3cb9/ACN_Wrap.lua)
